To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Environmental products contribute little to household income but a lot to food security and to the well-being and identity of rural households in Cameroon”.
environmental products are important for the livelihoods of the rural households of the humid forest zone in Cameroon, but their contribution to the household economy is relatively low.
environmental products, and NTFPs in particular, contribute to household income but not as a main source of income.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the actual contribution of environmental products (especially NTFPs) to rural livelihoods and the factors explaining this contribution.
a better understanding of the contribution of environmental products, particularly of NTFPs, to the household income and the livelihoods of the rural people in Cameroon.
the contribution of environmental products, in general, and NTFPs, in particular, to the livelihoods of the rural households.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
environmental products are essential in the East, complementary in the South and trivial in the Southwest.
the financial contribution of NTFP to the household economy is low but not negligible, while the role of NTFPs in the livelihoods and well-being of households is essential.
NTFPs are not essential but they are complementary to agriculture and they may even be considered trivial in the South and Southwest.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
environmental products are essential for the livelihoods of Bantu households in Cameroon but trivial for the Baka pygmides.
environmental products, especially NTFPs, are important in the livelihoods and food security of rural households.
environmental products contribute to the household income in Cameroon but this contribution is neither essential nor trivial.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the contribution of environmental products in the household economy is variable, and it can be significant when the environmental goods are highly valued by households.
the contribution of environmental products, and NTFPs in particular, to the household economy is not trivial.
environmental products, including NTFPs, are important in rural livelihoods and their importance is likely to increase in the future.
